content:
mariana: Quick heads-up - Kappa AI sent draft terms for listing their new 13B model in cloud marketplaces + cohost options. They want hosted + reseller rights in NA/EU, and a separate on-prem bundle for SI partners.

josh: Nice. Do they allow us to run in Dedicated/Dedicated+Private? Any export restrictions?

sarah-pm: From the draft: hosted + reseller, but export clause says 'no distribution to embargoed regions' and requires KMS for key custody on Private. I highlighted the ambiguous resale definition (are we allowed to sub-license to SIs?).

dennis-legal: Can you paste the exact clause? we need to know if "resale" includes co-hosted third-parties or only marketplace re-listing. If they used "redistribution" vs "resale" that's material.

sarah-pm: Snippet from section 4.2: ```Partner may offer Hosted Services and Resold Services to End Customers provided Partner does not transfer Model Weights or Engineered Checkpoints. Resold Services include co-hosting on Partner infrastructure or listings on Marketplace channels, subject to geo-fencing and export controls.```

dennis-legal: Thanks. That looks permissive but the "co-hosting on Partner infrastructure" line could block on-prem SI bundling that requires model artifacts. We should ask for a carve-out allowing SI integrators to ship an air-gapped appliance if it's under a support SLA.

anita-ops: Ops flag - for co-hosting we'll need E2E telemetry & usage contract points. Kappa also wants token-level telemetry for QA. Need to confirm PII/data retention limits and whether they allow hashed logs.

mariana: Agreed. Action items: (1) Confirm reseller/co-host definition carve-out for SI appliances, (2) Clarify KMS requirement and whether customer-managed KMS is sufficient, (3) Confirm telemetry fields allowed.

josh: Also product question: if we list on AWS Marketplace as a SaaS listing, do we need an additional SKU for Dedicated? Some marketplaces require separate SKUs for "hosted" vs "bring-your-own-hw" - we should baseline that with marketplace PM.

sarah-pm: I can sync with marketplace ops tomorrow. Also Kappa asked for an embargoed announcement window (2 weeks) and joint press language. They insisted on "no mention of benchmarks" in public materials without approval.

dennis-legal: For embargo + marketing approval, push for a 3-business-day signoff SLA on materials. Also request indemnity carve-out for third-party infra when resold.

anita-ops: Deployment constraint: if co-hosted and they require quantized weights for edge SKU, we need explicit permission to use 4-bit quantization and shipping of quantized artifacts to SIs. Right now clause forbids "transfer of model weights" which blocks that.

mariana: Good catch. I'll propose language: allow distribution of quantized runtime artifacts for SI edge bundles where weights are transformed and cannot be used to reconstruct original weights; add verification step.

josh: timeline? Kappa wants GA in 6 weeks with marketplace listing + 2 SI pilots. Feels tight if legal/tech signoff needs negotiating.

sarah-pm: Let's aim to get legal redlines by EOD Friday. I'll compile questions + propose amended clauses.

dennis-legal: I'll draft redlines for export/redistribution and the indemnity language. Expect comments by Friday noon.

anita-ops: I'll sketch an ops checklist for co-hosting + SI bundle (KMS options, telemetry schema, quant artifact verification) and upload to the partner drive.

mariana: Perfect. One more: Kappa requested regional pricing floors for marketplaces. Should we accept floors or push to revenue share only? Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

josh: Prefer revenue share only, but can accept temporary floor during launch. We should cap floors to 3 months.

dennis-legal: Make floor conditional and timeboxed in the agreement. I'll add that.

deploy-bot: Reminder: partnership-onboarding-template created a checklist item "marketing-announce-embargo" - due 2024-06-14.

mariana: Great - I'll follow up with Kappa & loop legal/product. Thanks all :rocket:
